question: How should the wise understand the rims with respect to height and width in all cases?
premises: The rims must be assessed in height and width.
This assessment applies in all respects.
The wise are the ones who should know this.
inference: The wise should know the rims in all respects with regard to their height and width.
plain_english: The wise should understand the rims in all respects with regard to their height and width.
